name: Buccar
personality: A loyal old soldier who calls Leda "princess" and wants her happiness more than her revenge.
story: Buccar (49-50, 54 post-timeskip) served Leda's father for over twenty years and fled Cydonia with Leda after his death, then accompanied her on her revenge quest despite his doubts about it. He joins Leda's route automatically, can be recruited on Dietrich and Theodora routes (Renown 8+, Support 3, clear Leda's Paralogue "Diversionary Tactics"), and is unavailable on Cai's route.

personalSkill.name: Guardian's Duty
personalSkill.effect: Reduces damage taken to 90% when attacked. Lv 20 and 35 add Retaliatory Blow variants (1.3x damage when a foe attacks first).

tierNotes: Pocket Tactics: B. KeenGamer: B (useful damage reduction but narrow impact).

why: Joins Leda's army with the story in Ch 1 (Lv 1 Commoner?): no Support or Renown to chase.
The path guide only has him defect to you on Turn 1 of the Ch 9 Cai battle; if he's missing before then, Jasmine stands in.

path: Guardian (Part II Ch 1 side trip: Brace)
build.notes: Armored all through Part I for the Def rows (Armored Knight +25, Dreadnought +30). One Part II map in Guardian for Brace. Castle Knight adds Intercept in Part III. Ranks to B from the Arena Heavy course; A ranks from battle.

guide.summary: The army's physical wall from Ch 1. Park him in the choke the enemy has to take and let Guardian's Duty (damage x0.9), a [[item:Bronze Axe]] +4 and his counter masteries work on enemy phase. Keep mages off him: his Res grows 10 to 20%, so the [[item:Hexlock Shield]] and Leda's Icewater cover mage maps.
guide.playstyle: Enemy phase first: end every turn where foes must hit him, with a Physic healer 2 tiles back. On player phase, [[art:Armored Blow]] a weak foe for Prt +3 into the enemy phase.
keys: Seat him in the Arena Heavy course weekly: Heavy D, Axe B, Spear B by Ch 11
Take [[class:Armored Knight]] at Lv 20 in Ch 6 and stay to Lv 35 for the Def +25 row
Take [[class:Dreadnought]] the day he shows Lv 35 (Ch 11)
Swap in the Hexlock Shield on Ch 11 and other mage maps, in place of the Silver Shield
Spend Part II Ch 1 in [[class:Guardian]] for [[ability:Brace]], then back to Dreadnought

guide.alt: [[class:Great Knight]] in Part III (Credna's request; Heavy D, Riding D, Axe A, Spear A) keeps swords for a [[item:Cleansing Blade]], but grows Def 60 against Castle Knight's 75.

decisions.topic: Stay armored all through Part I
decisions.why: Armored Knight (Def +25) and Dreadnought (Def +30) are the Def rows. Every Specialty class he qualifies for grows Def 15 to 20 points slower, and Def is his job.
decisions.else: Gladiator or Ornius Rider (the path guide's picks) if you want him mobile

decisions.topic: Spend Part II Ch 1 in Guardian
decisions.pick: Guardian on a free Part II Advanced License
decisions.why: [[ability:Brace]] (Prt +3 after a kill) sits in his slots from Part II Ch 2 to Part III. Res grows 35% for those levels. The cost is one map as infantry.
decisions.else: Back to Dreadnought after one map even if Brace hasn't shown

decisions.pick: Bronze Axe +4 in hand on enemy phase; Halberd +2 for armor and cavalry
decisions.why: Common ores take it to +4 by Ch 6 to 8: Hit 70 (Shielding and Iron Axe 65), Def +1, Wt 9. Focused Counter (Hit +10) and the Archer's Ring push counters past 75. Part III: +5, Mt 25, Def +3.
decisions.else: Halberd +2 in hand if axe counters show Hit under 75

decisions.pick: Jasmine (Ch 6 recruit) as the armored stand-in
decisions.why: One source has him join in Ch 1; the path guide only shows him defecting on Turn 1 of the Ch 9 Cai battle. If he isn't there before Ch 9, recruit Jasmine early and his exams slide one step back.

gates.text: No Buccar before Ch 9: recruit Jasmine in Ch 6 as the armored stand-in
Heavy D, Axe B, Spear B by Lv 35 (Ch 11): Arena Heavy course every week

routeNotes.note: Partners here: Leda, Sirocco, Mu, Olympia, Dadao, Jasmine, Ludia and Jester. Meal seat: Leda + Buccar + Olympia (all three pairs support).
Icewater (Def/Res +4, +7 after Captain's Drink Recipes) on enemy phases he can't avoid; Abjuring is his undead answer in Ch 11 and Part III.
Arena Heavy course every week from Ch 5 (Spear, Axe, Heavy, Authority). Authority C also teaches [[ability:Rein]]: foe Avo −3 when adjacent.
